name: Spring Check
description: A checkbox that fills when checked, draws a check and strikes through its text.
interactionNotes: On each click, the box fills from the center, swells a little and the check appears; at the same time the text dims and a line passes through it. Space and Enter do the same, but without animation.

props.name: label
props.description: The text next to the box; it can be any node, not just a string.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled value. If you want it uncontrolled, don't pass this.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Returns the new state on every change.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims it and makes it unclickable.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink color: the box outline, the text and the line through the text all use it. Its default changes with the theme.

props.name: fillColor
props.description: Fill color of the box in the checked state.

props.name: checkColor
props.description: Color of the check itself; it must contrast with fillColor.

props.name: boxSize
props.description: Side of the box, pixels. Below 24 the outline thickness goes from 2 to 1.5.

props.name: boxRadius
props.description: Corner radius of the box; at half of boxSize it becomes fully round.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Font size of the text; the strikethrough thickness is calculated from it too.

props.name: bounce
props.description: Spring bounciness, between 0 and 1. Zero means fully damped; above 0.4 it looks too jittery.

props.name: strikeLag
props.description: How much of the motion progress passes before the line starts. Zero means at the same time as the fill.

props.name: doneOpacity
props.description: Final text opacity in the done state; one means the text doesn't dim at all.

props.name: strike
props.description: Which side the line is drawn from. The default is right for Persian text (the reading start); for English text it is left.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Screen reader label. It isn't needed if `label` has readable text, but always give it when you put an icon next to it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the button itself.

tips: For todo lists, set `bounce` around 0.1 and `strikeLag` to zero; less motion is better.
If you use a brand color, watch the contrast of `fillColor` and `checkColor`; otherwise the check won't be visible.
With `strike="none"` the text only dims; that is better for long labels.
